$doc: What the kernel asks of the host that no command answers, as records in a stream
(xpute-runtime ipc/stream.rs) the host runs once each turn has returned
(pxl-kernel host.rs, apps/web/src/kernel/host.ts). A record may name memory the
kernel holds: the host reads or writes it before the next turn, and the kernel
Its head is the stream's END alone.
The range's size. A record names what it moves rather than carrying it, so
a turn's records are words, and a glyph request's code points the most of them.
A record's operation, then its arguments.
body, at, len: the body the host holds copied to `at`, `len` bytes, and let go; a `len` of 0 only lets it go
key, at, len: the UTF-8 at `at` stored under `storage`'s key
weight, px (f32 bits), at, then code points: each one's advance in the page's own
family at the weight and size, a float apiece from `at`
errno, line, column, a (low, high word), b (low, high word), then the file's bytes:
the broken invariant the kernel reported before it trapped (xpute-core status/bug.rs)
What the kernel keeps in the browser's storage, by the key the host keeps it under (`STORAGE_KEYS`).
The keys, in `storage`'s order. The objects' carries the encoding's version: a blob
of an older one is not read, so bump it whenever a change makes an older entry
mean something other than it meant when it was written (layer/object/store.rs).
